admin.help:
🛠️ *Amri za Admin*

*QUICK_ADD <jina>|<maelezo>|<bei>|<idadi>* — ongeza bidhaa
   Mfano: QUICK_ADD iPhone 15|Simu mpya|3500000|25

*ORDERS* — tazama maagizo yote
*ORDERS APPROVED* — chuja kwa hali
*APPROVE <agizo>* — idhinisha agizo
*REJECT <agizo> <sababu>* — kataa agizo
*PAY <agizo>* — omba malipo kutoka kwa mteja
*CONFIRM_PAYMENT <agizo> <njia> <kumbukumbu>* — thibitisha malipo
*DELIVER <agizo> [maelezo]* — weka kama imefikishwa
*TRACK <agizo>* — tazama maelezo ya agizo
*PRODUCTS* — orodhesha bidhaa zote
*HELP* — onyesha menyu hii
